new_nodes.label: Bounded Gaussian Incompatibility
new_nodes.statement: An almost-surely bounded multivariate Gaussian vector is degenerate in every component; a non-degenerate exact Gaussian law cannot be the exact law of observed W_i in [-1,1]^8.
new_nodes.domain: Finite-dimensional Gaussian vectors and the exact observed bounded R161/R162 contrast vector; approximate or explicit latent Gaussian models are not excluded.
new_nodes.scope: Finite-dimensional Gaussian vectors and the exact observed bounded R161/R162 contrast vector; approximate or explicit latent Gaussian models are not excluded.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Elementary Gaussian marginal support applied to the R161/R162 exact bounded target.
new_nodes.proof: Every positive-variance Gaussian marginal has positive probability outside [-1,1]; almost-sure boundedness forces all marginal variances and the covariance matrix to zero.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A degenerate point mass is both bounded and Gaussian; an unbounded latent Gaussian variable is a different target after clipping.

new_nodes.label: Bounded Student Coverage Counterexample
new_nodes.statement: Student-Bonferroni intervals lack uniform finite-sample simultaneous coverage over bounded laws; at N=36 and m=8, the saved mean-zero two-point law has exact simultaneous coverage 0.2531493943720002 at nominal 0.95.
new_nodes.domain: The fixed Student interval family, independent observations and components, and the explicit two-point law supported in [-1,1].
new_nodes.scope: The fixed Student interval family, independent observations and components, and the explicit two-point law supported in [-1,1].
new_nodes.source_lineage: Exact binomial enumeration in stress_test.py and STRESS_TEST_RESULTS.json.
new_nodes.proof: Enumerate every binomial success count and sum its exact probability when the Student interval contains the known mean zero; eighth-power gives independent-component simultaneous coverage.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Rejects a universal bounded guarantee, not all uses or asymptotic approximations of Student intervals.

new_nodes.label: Frozen Bounded Finite-Design Target
new_nodes.statement: For a frozen N-participant design with independent W_i and W_ij in [-1,1], theta_Nj=N^{-1} sum_i E[W_ij] is the finite-design target, including any frozen randomization distribution in the expectation.
new_nodes.domain: One fixed R161 protocol, component order, participant positions/strata/randomization law and independent participant vectors; laws need not be identical.
new_nodes.scope: One fixed R161 protocol, component order, participant positions/strata/randomization law and independent participant vectors; laws need not be identical.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Target definition introduced to block i.i.d./finite-design, order-mixture/canonical-order, clipped/latent and statistical/experiential shifts.
new_nodes.proof: Definition; no empirical truth or experience-level identity is inferred.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Participant dependence or post-outcome target changes require another theorem.

new_nodes.label: Bounded Planwise Simultaneous Coverage
new_nodes.statement: For independent participant vectors with each frozen component in [-1,1], Bonferroni-Hoeffding intervals with half-width sqrt(2 log(2m/alpha)/N) simultaneously cover all finite-design component means with probability at least 1-alpha; component independence and identical participant laws are unnecessary.
new_nodes.domain: R163 bounded finite-design target, fixed N,m and interval family, independent participant vectors, and no same-data target or family selection.
new_nodes.scope: R163 bounded finite-design target, fixed N,m and interval family, independent participant vectors, and no same-data target or family selection.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Hoeffding 1963 plus a union bound, typed through the R162 independent-pilot coverage contract.
new_nodes.proof: Range-two Hoeffding gives alpha/m two-sided failure for each component; union bound gives alpha; R162 tower property transports coverage across independent pilot-selected plans.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Conservative: m=8, alpha=.05 and half-width .05 require N>=4615; participant dependence, invalid bounds or adaptive family selection break the proof.

new_nodes.label: Arbitrary-Missingness Bounded Confidence Band
new_nodes.statement: For well-defined Y_ij in [-1,1], L=RY-(1-R) and U=RY+(1-R) bound Y pointwise; [mean L-h_N, mean U+h_N] intersect [-1,1] simultaneously covers all full-data finite-design means with probability at least 1-alpha under arbitrary missingness and independent participants.
new_nodes.domain: Well-defined bounded would-be outcomes for every enrollee, frozen target and components, arbitrary observation indicators, independent participant records.
new_nodes.scope: Well-defined bounded would-be outcomes for every enrollee, frozen target and components, arbitrary observation indicators, independent participant records.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Manski support-bound logic plus 2m one-sided Hoeffding events and a union bound.
new_nodes.proof: Pointwise E[L]<=E[Y]<=E[U]; one-sided Hoeffding errors alpha/(2m) for every lower and upper endpoint; union bound over 2m events.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Can be vacuous; if safety makes Y undefined, the full-data target is invalid rather than missing.

new_nodes.label: Order and Clipping Target Boundary
new_nodes.statement: Coverage for a frozen randomized-order mixture mean does not entail order invariance or a canonical-order effect; coverage for clipped W identifies only the clipped mean, not an unrestricted unclipped latent mean.
new_nodes.domain: R161/R162 observed bounded outcomes under frozen order assignment/randomization and any latent interpretation linked only through clipping.
new_nodes.scope: R161/R162 observed bounded outcomes under frozen order assignment/randomization and any latent interpretation linked only through clipping.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Exact order-target and clipping countermodels plus R160 tokenwise application boundary.
new_nodes.proof: W=.4O+epsilon separates mixture mean 0 from canonical-order mean .4; latent constants 2 and 100 induce identical clipped W=1 laws.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Additional mechanistic assumptions, conditional-order estimation or unclipped measurements may identify narrower targets.

new_rules.statement: The fixed bounded R161 protocol, independent pilot-freeze contract and explicit finite-design target jointly permit a range-based planwise interval whose simultaneous coverage is finite-sample valid for independent participant vectors.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Apply range-two Hoeffding to each frozen component, union-bound m failures, then apply R162's tower theorem to independent pilot-selected plans.

new_rules.statement: For the frozen bounded target, pointwise support bounds and simultaneous one-sided Hoeffding errors yield a full-data mean band under arbitrary missingness when every would-be outcome is defined.
new_rules.proof_sketch: L<=Y<=U pointwise; union-bound lower and upper concentration failures across all components.

new_rules.statement: Tokenwise application discipline and an explicit finite-design target jointly block inference from mixture to canonical order and from clipped observation to unrestricted latent effect.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Two exact countermodels preserve the observed analysis object while changing the proposed stronger target.
